vocab.example: We sent a payment reminder to the client yesterday.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi đã gửi nhắc nhở thanh toán cho khách hàng hôm qua.

vocab.example: Please quote the invoice number when you make the payment.
vocab.example_vi: Vui lòng ghi rõ số hóa đơn khi thanh toán.

vocab.example: This overdue invoice needs to be settled by Friday.
vocab.example_vi: Hóa đơn quá hạn này cần được thanh toán trước thứ Sáu.

vocab.example: We usually pay large invoices by wire transfer.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi thường thanh toán hóa đơn lớn bằng chuyển khoản ngân hàng.

vocab.example: There's a small payment discrepancy we need to check.
vocab.example_vi: Có một sự chênh lệch thanh toán nhỏ chúng ta cần kiểm tra.

vocab.example: Could you send us proof of payment for that invoice?
vocab.example_vi: Bạn có thể gửi chứng từ thanh toán cho hóa đơn đó không?

vocab.example: Our credit terms with this supplier are thirty days.
vocab.example_vi: Điều khoản công nợ của chúng tôi với nhà cung cấp này là ba mươi ngày.

vocab.example: The amount is small, so we can just write off.
vocab.example_vi: Số tiền nhỏ, nên chúng ta có thể xóa nợ luôn.

listening.title: Hóa đơn quá hạn và thanh toán

lines.speaker: Khoa (accountant)
lines.text: An, did we get a payment reminder from the supplier again?

lines.speaker: An (accountant)
lines.text: Yes, it's about invoice number INV-2291. It's overdue now.

lines.speaker: Khoa (accountant)
lines.text: Right, that overdue invoice was due last week. Did we already pay it?

lines.speaker: An (accountant)
lines.text: I checked our records, and I don't see any wire transfer for it yet.

lines.speaker: Khoa (accountant)
lines.text: Let's check with the vendor. Maybe there's a payment discrepancy somewhere.

lines.speaker: An (accountant)
lines.text: Good idea. I'll ask them to send proof of payment if they think it's paid.

lines.speaker: Khoa (accountant)
lines.text: And if it turns out we really missed it, let's process it today.

lines.speaker: An (accountant)
lines.text: Agreed. Do we still have 30-day credit terms with this supplier?

lines.speaker: Khoa (accountant)
lines.text: Yes, so we're actually within the grace period, just cutting it close.

lines.speaker: An (accountant)
lines.text: Okay, I'll arrange the wire transfer this afternoon.

lines.speaker: Khoa (accountant)
lines.text: Great. And if it's a really small amount, sometimes it's easier to just write off.

lines.speaker: An (accountant)
lines.text: True, but this one's too large to write off. Let's just pay it properly.
